description: The GJ-06 RTO is the primary transport office for Vadodara City, Gujarat. It handles a wide range of services including vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and road tax collection for the urban areas of Vadodara. It plays a crucial role in managing the transport infrastructure of the 'Sanskari Nagari' of Gujarat.
address: Regional Transport Office, Near Sant Kanwar Colony, Warasiya, Vadodara, Gujarat
